subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and
stimulus: column 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required.15 = 5 Column A Column B (a) Good manners (i) without acquisition of good manners. (b) Good manners help us (ii) decency in dealing with others. (c) Man's learning can't be (iii) constitute part of our complete education.
